subject: Redwood demo: NextWave integration & security check
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Brian Lee <brian.lee@nextwave.io>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood demo: NextWave integration & security check

Hi Brian —

Thanks again for the interest and for pulling together your SE/security folks. Per our call last week, I want to lock in the joint demo and a short security walkthrough so your team can validate the integration path and SSO options. Proposed slots (PT):

- Wed Aug 5, 10:00–11:00 (preferred)
- Thu Aug 6, 14:00–15:00
- Mon Aug 10, 09:00–10:00

Agenda (30–45 min demo + 15 min security/ops Q&A):
- Quick context & success metrics
- Live demo: Dedicated + Private routing example
- SSO/KMS and data isolation notes (Rafael will cover)
- Next steps & procurement touchpoints (Marissa)

Attached: NW-demo-agenda-v2.pdf, redwood-sso-integration-notes.md, pricing-summary-NW-139.xlsx

If you prefer a different time, we can pivot — Rafael, Priyom and Marissa are on standby to join.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

---
Redwood Inference — Make inference predictable and economical.
From: Brian Lee <brian.lee@nextwave.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: NextWave Security Team <security@nextwave.io>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@nextwave.io>, Procurement Team <procure@nextwave.io>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo: NextWave integration & security check

Hannah —

Appreciate the options and materials. Two blockers on our side that will force a short hold: 1) We are experiencing a partial outage in our lab environment and the lead eng for the integration is traveling for the rest of the week; 2) our security team opened a quick review after a recent vendor audit and wants to run the SSO/KMS notes by our SOC engineer before any live demo that touches connectivity.

We'd like to push the session until next week at the earliest (targeting Tue Aug 11/ Wed Aug 12). Also, procurement asked if you can share a one-page procurement checklist (licenses, data residency, contract lead times) so they can prepare — I cc'd Laura and procurement for visibility.

Sorry for the churn — we want the demo but need the right folks present. Can you and your team be flexible?

Thanks,
Brian
Brian Lee
Platform Engineer, NextWave IoT
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo: NextWave integration & security check

Team — looping you in. Summary: NextWave hit a lab outage and lead eng is OOO for travel; security wants to run our SSO/KMS notes before a live session. Procurement also requested a checklist.

Options I see (ranked):
1) Move demo to Tue Aug 11 or Wed Aug 12 (customer preference). Rafael: can you lead the security segment and be prepared to do a gated walkthrough if their SOC wants to join?
2) Run the demo without the lab hands-on — streaming the demo with recordings of the dedicated routing and a short sandbox walkthrough (lower risk). Priyom: can you prepare a 10-min pre-recorded snippet for the dedicated routing path by EOD tomorrow?
3) If NextWave needs more time, propose a two-part cadence: security/arch deep-dive first (30–45m), then product demo with engs the following week.

Marissa — I'll prepare the procurement one-pager and push it to the Drive link; can you also confirm estimated lead times on reserved capacity?

Sofia — if SOC joins live, we may need a quick redaction note for logs and a separate Q&A channel. Can you surface any legal/compliance constraints we should flag in the checklist?

Brian — totally fine to be flexible. We'll aim to have at least two fallback dates and the procurement checklist ready.

Thanks,
Hannah

Subject: Re: Redwood demo: security walkthrough + reschedule options

Hi all —

I can lead the security walkthrough for Tue Aug 11 (I have a 10:30–11:30 PT open) and Weds Aug 12 (free 13:00–15:00 PT). If NextWave wants a gated session with SOC, I recommend we:

- Provide the SSO/KMS notes and an architecture diagram in advance (I will export a redacted diagram)
- Limit live connectivity tests (do sandbox for live tokens)
- Keep an internal-only Q&A channel for any PII/log questions

Priyom: I can use a short recorded clip of the dedicated routing if you can get it done by EOD tomorrow. Marissa: for procurement, typical lead times are 4–6 weeks for reserved capacity slots; I can add a note about upgrade windows and SLA start dates.

I'll attach the redacted architecture as a stub in the Drive link.

-Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Drive: https://drive.company.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-nw-demo-resources

Brian — can you confirm whether Tue 11 10:30 PT works for SOC? If yes we'll lock the calendar.

Thanks,

Best,
Brian
